patterns.note: Dominant use of full-bleed, high-resolution photography to introduce sections and categories, creating an immersive visual experience.
A highly stylized, elegant script font is reserved exclusively for the brand logo, contrasting with a clean, modern sans-serif for all functional text and navigation.
A minimalist black and white UI palette is consistently applied, allowing the rich, natural colors of the product photography to provide the primary visual interest.
The primary navigation bar dynamically reduces its height and becomes sticky at the top of the viewport upon scrolling, maintaining accessibility while optimizing screen real estate.
Large, full-width photographic sections serve as visual anchors and category entry points, often featuring minimal text overlays to maintain focus on the imagery.

technique_notes: Implement a header that initially appears at a taller height, then smoothly transitions to a more compact, fixed position at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down.
Utilize full-bleed, high-resolution images as primary content blocks and section dividers, ensuring they span the full width of the browser and serve as the main visual focus.
Employ a large, stylized brand logo as a significant graphic element within the page content, particularly in transitional or footer-like sections, to reinforce brand identity.

design_tokens.type_scale: A prominent, elegant script for the brand mark, contrasted with a clean, modern sans-serif where headings are moderately sized and body text is small and highly legible.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are consistently used across all elements, including images and interactive components.
design_tokens.spacing: An airy and spacious layout, particularly in hero and full-bleed image sections, with balanced spacing for text blocks and product grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and luxurious presentation of product photography, utilizing full-bleed, editorial-style images as core structural and navigational elements rather than mere embellishments. This creates an immersive brand experience that feels more like a high-fashion magazine spread than a typical e-commerce site.
